messages.subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 12th February - agenda
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

Here is a quick reminder that we have our Airflow dev call tomorrow on
Thursday, 12th February 2026 at 8AM PST (11 am EST | 4 pm UTC / GMT). The
agenda is fairly full, but if you have additional quick topics to squeeze
in, feel free to add on the wiki page or slack me.

Proposed agenda:

   - Catch-up on action items from last call
      - TBD
   - Swim lane updates:
      - UI Test framework (Rahul Vats):
      - UI / API  (Pierre Jeambrun):
   - Airflow 3.2 development updates:
      - Asset Partitions (Wei Lee):
      - Deadline Alerts (Dennis Ferruzzi):
      - Multi-team (Niko / Vincent):
   - Discussion topics:
   - AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI update - Pavan
      - AIP-100 Eliminate Scheduler Starvation on Concurrency Limits -
      Natanel
      - TBD



For additions to the agenda, please feel free to add a comment to the wiki
page
<https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=373886699#Airflow3.xDevCall:Meetingnotes-ProposedAgenda.32>
or
send me an email. The summary of the call will also be sent to the mailing
list and posted on the same wiki page.

As a reminder the zoom link is
https://astronomer.zoom.us/j/84124767391?pwd=3vatlR8OuF6Uy2JbOcKrw6034CayFG.1


Looking forward to seeing you all soon,
Vikram

--

Vikram Koka
Chief Strategy Officer
